question: What two physiological imbalances simultaneously characterize the condition of asphyxia?

options.A: Hypoxia and hypocapnia
options.B: Hypoxia and hypercapnia
options.C: Hyperoxia and hypocapnia
options.D: Hyperoxia and hypercapnia

explanation: Asphyxia is defined as the deprivation of oxygen leading to hypoxia combined with hypercapnia, which is an excess of carbon dioxide in the blood. [learn more](GNS123_U3_T8#GNS123_U3_T8_h1)
